title: 干扰项的类型
goal: 识别五类应答干扰项，并按话语功能、信息类别、人物和时间逐项排除。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 应答题的干扰项常沿用录音里的词或相近的声音，却没有回应对方。重复了原词的选项不一定错。词相同而意思或用意不同的，才是干扰项。

body.box: Could you change this note into coins? → I noted the change yesterday.

body.p: 例句是请对方把纸币换成硬币，回应却把 note 当成记录的意思。它重复了 note 和 change，没有说能不能换。下面按主要错因分类，一个选项也可能错在几处。

steps.d: 先判断对方要的是信息还是行动。Could you change this note? 是请对方兑换。When can I change it? 才是问时间。
选项里有相同的词或相近的声音时，放回整句里看意思。在兑换的请求里，note 指纸币，不是记录。
排除答非所问和只答字面的选项。Do you know where the desk is? 要的是位置，I know 没有给出位置。
最后核对时间和做事的人。When will you return it? 问对方将来什么时候还，She returned hers yesterday 说的是别人过去的事。

cards.title: 干扰项的五种类型
rows: 重复听到的词
Could you change this note? → I noted the change.
note 在请求里指纸币，回应当成了记录。
近音词
Where can I buy a sheet of paper? → The sheep are outside.
sheet 和 sheep 发音相近，指的不是同一样东西。
答非所问
Where is the rehearsal? → It starts at six.
问地点，答的是开始时间。
只答字面
Do you know where the desk is? → I know.
只说知道，没有说出地点。
时态或人称不符
When will you return it? → She returned hers yesterday.
问对方将来的事，答的是别人过去的事。

cards.title: 辨析
rows: 重复听到的词
Can you book a court? → The book has a hard cover.
Sure, I can reserve one for tomorrow.
近音词
What is the daily rate? → It usually rains at night.
Twenty dollars per day.
答非所问
Who checks the permits? → Before noon.
The safety officer does.
只答字面
Could you tell me the fee? → Yes, I could.
It costs eight dollars.
时态或人称不符
Have you sent the invoice? → My colleague sends hers weekly.
Yes, I emailed it this morning.
cards.note: 近音词靠听到的声音和句意判断，不看拼写。rate 和 rain 这样的词，放回所谈的事里就能分开。

body.box: Could you tell me where to weigh this bag?

Choose the best response.
1. Yes, I can tell you.
2. I waited here yesterday.
3. There's a scale by the service desk.
4. The bag weighs eight kilos.

body.p: 第一项只说能告诉，没有给出地点，属于只答字面。第二项把 weigh 听成了发音相近的 wait，说的是过去等候的事。
第四项给出重量，不是称重的地点，属于答非所问。第三项的 scale 是秤，by the service desk 说明秤在服务台旁边，回答了 where to weigh。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 话语功能
Can you book it? → The book is new.
有 book，但未回应预订请求。
语境中的声音
weigh → wait
weigh 是称重，wait 是等候，意思不同。
信息类别
where to weigh → eight kilos
重量不是称重地点。
实际信息
Could you tell me where? → I can.
只说能告诉，没有给出地点。
人物与时间
Have you sent it? → She sends hers weekly.
别人的习惯，回答不了这次做了没有。

lines.text: Where can I hire a drill?

items.stem: Why is 'Five dollars an hour' unsuitable?
options: It gives a price instead of a location.
It gives a location instead of a price.
It answers for a different person.
It changes a future booking into a past one.
items.why: Where can I hire 问在哪里租，Five dollars an hour 答的是租金，属于答非所问，即第一项。

lines.text: Could you tell me the opening time?

options: It describes the opening time of the wrong building.
It gives the time the place opened in the past.
It confuses time with a similar sound.
It confirms ability without giving the time.
items.why: Could you tell me the opening time 要的是时间，Yes, I can 只说能告诉，属于只答字面，即第四项。

items.stem: Why is 'A nail file is in my bag' unsuitable?
options: It answers with the wrong filing date.
It takes file in a different sense from the request.
It reports that the receipts were already filed last week.
It gives the location where filing is required.
items.why: file these receipts 的 file 是归档，A nail file is in my bag 的 file 是指甲锉。词相同，意思变了，即第二项。

lines.text: Will you deliver the baskets tomorrow?

items.stem: Why is 'I delivered them last week' insufficient?
options: It gives a delivery price instead of a delivery day.
It confuses baskets with a similar sound.
It describes a past delivery, not tomorrow's.
It gives a location instead of a delivery method.
items.why: Will … tomorrow 问明天送不送，I delivered them last week 说的是过去，没有回答明天的事，即第三项。

lines.text: Do you know where the spare sails are stored?

options: I know where they're stored.
The sails cost a great deal.
They're in the boathouse loft.
We sailed there last summer.
items.why: where … stored 问放在哪里，第三项答在船库的阁楼上。第一项只说知道，没有说出地点。

lines.text: Who is going to check the fire extinguisher?

options: The safety inspector is.
It was checked last month.
The check takes ten minutes.
The extinguisher is near the exit.
items.why: Who 问由谁检查，第一项答安全检查员。其余三项分别答了过去的时间、时长和位置。

lines.text: What is the fare for the night tram?

options: The fair closes at night.
Yes, I'll pay the fare for you.
The night service runs hourly.
A single ride costs three dollars.
items.why: fare 问车费，第四项给出价钱。第一项的 fair 与 fare 同音，意思是集市。

lines.text: Could you reserve a booth for our craft fair?

options: The booth is made of wood.
Sure, I'll contact the organizer today.
I reserved a booth for another group last year.
Thanks, I'd love to visit your booth.
items.why: Could you reserve 是请对方订摊位，第二项答应今天就联系主办方。第三项说的是去年给别人订的。

lines.text: Could you give me a hand lifting this bench?

items.stem: Why is 'I have two hands' unsuitable?
options: It takes a request for help as a remark about hands.
It changes a lifting request into a past action.
It gives the place where the bench should be moved.
It answers for another person instead of the speaker.
items.why: give me a hand lifting 是请对方帮忙抬，I have two hands 只按 hand 的字面意思回应，即第一项。

lines.text: Where can I get a permit for the pier?

items.stem: Why is 'My peers are in the next room' unsuitable?
options: It gives a time instead of a location.
It answers a question about permit prices.
It connects pier with the similar sound peer.
It describes a future visit instead of a current one.
items.why: permit for the pier 指码头的许可证。My peers are in the next room 把 pier 听成了同音的 peer，即第三项。

lines.text: Have you reserved the dance studio for tonight?

items.stem: Why is 'My sister reserves hers every Monday' unsuitable?
options: It gives tonight’s location instead of the booking time.
It describes someone else's routine, not this booking.
It confuses the word studio with a similar sound.
It confirms ability without stating a reservation price.
items.why: Have you reserved … tonight 问这次订了没有，My sister reserves hers every Monday 说的是别人的习惯，即第二项。

items.stem: Why is 'My address has changed' unsuitable?
options: It refuses the request to write on the envelopes.
It describes an earlier delivery of the envelopes.
It gives a deadline instead of the number of envelopes.
It treats address as a place, not the requested action.
items.why: address these envelopes 是请对方在信封上写地址。My address has changed 把 address 当成住址，即第四项。

lines.text: When should I bring the antique vase for inspection?

options: Yes, please bring it with you.
The inspector is in the back room.
Any time after two tomorrow.
The inspection costs twenty dollars.
items.why: When should I bring 问什么时候送来，第三项答明天两点以后。第二项答的是地点。

lines.text: Can you tell me how to release this clamp?

options: Press the lever beside the handle.
Yes, I know how it works.
The clamp was released yesterday.
The handle is made of plastic.
items.why: how to release 问怎么松开，第一项给出操作：按把手旁边的杆。第二项只说知道，没有说方法。

lines.text: Where does the courier collect outgoing mail?

options: The male assistant arrives early.
The collection takes place daily.
The courier collected it yesterday.
By the loading entrance at the back.
items.why: Where 问在哪里取件，第四项答在后面的装货入口。第一项的 male 与 mail 同音，意思不同。

lines.text: Could you check the balance on this gift card?

options: I try to balance work and rest.
Sure, I'll scan it at the counter.
The card was a gift last year.
I checked a different card earlier.
items.why: check the balance 是请对方查卡里的余额，第二项答应去柜台扫卡查询。第一项的 balance 是平衡的意思。
